text: Thou also art in a perpetual change, yea and under corruption too, in some part: and so is the whole world. it is not thine, but another man's sin. Why should it trouble thee? Let him look to it, whose sin it is. Of an operation and of a purpose there is an ending, or of an action and of a purpose we say commonly, that it is at an end: from opinion also there is an absolute cessation, which is as it were the death of it.
